directive in CSS.\n\n### Official Plugins (Tailwind Labs)\n\n#### Typography Plugin - Style Markdown/CMS Content\n\nWhen to use: Displaying blog posts, documentation, or any HTML from Markdown/CMS.\n\nInstallation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm add -D @tailwindcss/typography\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nConfiguration (v4 syntax):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;css\n/* src/index.css */\n@import \"tailwindcss\";\n@plugin \"@tailwindcss/typography\";\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nUsage:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;html\n\u003carticle class=\"prose lg:prose-xl dark:prose-invert\"\u003e\n  {{ markdown_content }}\n\u003c/article\u003e\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAvailable classes:\n\n- &#96;prose&#96;- Base typography styles\n- &#96;prose-sm&#96;,&#96;prose-base&#96;,&#96;prose-lg&#96;,&#96;prose-xl&#96;,&#96;prose-2xl&#96;- Size variants\n- &#96;dark:prose-invert&#96;- Dark mode styles\n\n---\n\n#### Forms Plugin - Reset Form Element Styles\n\nWhen to use: Building custom forms without shadcn/ui components, or need consistent cross-browser form styling.\n\nInstallation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm add -D @tailwindcss/forms\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nConfiguration (v4 syntax):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;css\n/* src/index.css */\n@import \"tailwindcss\";\n@plugin \"@tailwindcss/forms\";\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWhat it does:\n\n- Resets browser default form styles\n- Makes form elements styleable with Tailwind utilities\n- Fixes cross-browser inconsistencies for inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios\n\nNote: Less critical for shadcn/ui users (they have pre-styled form components), but still useful for basic forms.\n\n---\n\n### Common Plugin Errors\n\nThese errors happen when using v3 syntax in v4 projects:\n\n❌ WRONG (v3 config file syntax):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;js\n// tailwind.config.js\nmodule.exports = {\n  plugins: [require('@tailwindcss/typography')]\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n❌ WRONG (@import instead of @plugin):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;css\n@import \"@tailwindcss/typography\"; [postgres-drizzle by ccheney/robust-skills](https://skills.sh/ccheney/robust-skills/postgres-drizzle)\n\n# Drizzle ORM on skills.sh\n\nDrizzle ORM is a modern TypeScript-first ORM with zero dependencies, compile-time type safety, and SQL-like syntax, optimized for edge runtimes and serverless environments.[1]\n\n## Installation \u0026 Setup\n\nInstall the core package and a database driver:[1]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install drizzle-orm\nnpm install pg            # PostgreSQL\nnpm install mysql2        # MySQL\nnpm install better-sqlite3 # SQLite\nnpm install -D drizzle-kit # For migrations\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Basic Usage\n\nDefine a schema, create a database client, then use the query builder API:[1]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { pgTable, serial, text, timestamp } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';\nexport const users = pgTable('users', {\n  id: serial('id').primaryKey(),\n  email: text('email').notNull().unique(),\n  name: text('name').notNull(),\n  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow(),\n});\n\n// Query examples\nawait db.insert(users).values({ email: 'user@example.com', name: 'John' });\nconst allUsers = await db.select().from(users);\nawait db.update(users).set({ name: 'Jane' }).where(eq(users.id, 1));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Database-Specific Skills\n\n**Cloudflare D1**: Use &#96;db.batch()&#96; for transactions instead of SQL BEGIN/COMMIT, test migrations locally first, and use &#96;integer&#96; with &#96;mode: 'timestamp'&#96; for dates.[2]\n\n**PostgreSQL**: Always index foreign keys, use the relational queries API to avoid N+1 queries, and enable connection pooling in production.[5]\n\n## Key Tools\n\n- &#96;drizzle-kit generate&#96; - Generate SQL migrations from schema changes[1]\n- &#96;drizzle-kit studio&#96; - Visual database browser[2]\n- &#96;drizzle-kit push&#96; - Push schema directly (dev only)[5]",

Static (Auto-Prerendered)\n\nSynchronous code, imports, pure computations - prerendered at build time:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nexport default function Page() {\n  return (\n    \u003cheader\u003e\n      \u003ch1\u003eOur Blog\u003c/h1\u003e  {/* Static - instant */}\n      \u003cnav\u003e...\u003c/nav\u003e\n    \u003c/header\u003e\n  )\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Cached (use cache)\n\nAsync data that doesn't need fresh fetches every request:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nasync function BlogPosts() {\n  'use cache'\n  cacheLife('hours')\n\n  const posts = await db.posts.findMany()\n  return \u003cPostList posts={posts} /\u003e\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. streams in */}\n      \u003c/Suspense\u003e\n    \u003c/\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nasync function UserPreferences() {\n  const theme = (await cookies()).get('theme')?.value\n  return \u003cp\u003eTheme: {theme}\u003c/p\u003e\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## use cache Directive\n\n### File Level\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n'use cache'\n\nexport default async function Page() {\n  // Entire page is cached\n  const data = await fetchData()\n  return \u003cdiv\u003e{data}\u003c/div\u003e\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Component Level\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nexport async function CachedComponent() {\n  'use cache'\n  const data = await fetchData()\n  return \u003cdiv\u003e{data}\u003c/div\u003e\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Function Level\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nexport async function getData() {\n  'use cache'\n  return db.query('SELECT * FROM posts')\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Cache Profiles\n\n### Built-in Profiles\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n'use cache'                    // Default: 5m stale, 15m revalidate\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n'use cache: remote'           // Platform-provided cache (Redis, KV)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n'use cache: private'          // For compliance, allows runtime APIs\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### cacheLife() - Custom Lifetime\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { cacheLife } from 'next/cache'\n\nasync function getData() {\n  'use cache'\n  cacheLife('hours')  // Built-in profile\n  return fetch('/api/data')\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nBuilt-in profiles:&#96;'default'&#96;,&#96;'minutes'&#96;,&#96;'hours'&#96;,&#96;'days'&#96;,&#96;'weeks'&#96;,&#96;'max'&#96;\n\n### Inline Configuration\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nasync function getData() {\n  'use cache'\n  cacheLife({\n    stale: 3600,      // 1 hour - serve stale while revalidating\n    revalidate: 7200, // 2 hours - background revalidation interval\n    expire: 86400,    // 1 day - hard expiration\n  })\n  return fetch('/api/data')\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Cache Invalidation\n\n### cacheTag() - next request sees fresh data\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Runtime Data Constraint\n\nCannot access&#96;cookies()&#96;,&#96;headers()&#96;, or&#96;searchParams&#96; inside&#96;use cache&#96;.\n\n### Solution: Pass as Arguments\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Wrong - runtime API inside use cache\nasync function CachedProfile() {\n  'use cache'\n  const session = (await cookies()).get('session')?.value  // Error!\n  return \u003cdiv\u003e{session}\u003c/div\u003e\n}\n\n// Correct - extract outside, pass as argument\nasync function ProfilePage() {\n  const session = (await cookies()).get('session')?.value\n  return \u003cCachedProfile sessionId={session} /\u003e\n}\n\nasync function CachedProfile({ sessionId }: { sessionId: string }) {\n  'use cache'\n  // sessionId becomes part of cache key automatically\n  const data = await fetchUserData(sessionId)\n  return \u003cdiv\u003e{data.name}\u003c/div\u003e\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Exception: use cache: private\n\nFor compliance requirements when you can't refactor:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nasync function getData() {\n  'use cache: private'\n  const session = (await cookies()).get('session')?.value  // Allowed\n  return fetchData(session)\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Cache Key Generation\n\nCache keys are automatic based on:\n\n- Build ID - invalidates all caches on deploy\n- Function ID - hash of function location\n- Serializable arguments - props become part of key\n- Closure variables - outer scope values included\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nasync function Component({ userId }: { userId: string }) {\n  const getData = async (filter: string) =\u003e {\n    'use cache'\n    // Cache key = userId (closure) + filter (argument)\n    return fetch(&#96;/api/users/${userId}?filter=${filter}&#96;)\n  }\n  return getData('active')\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Complete Example\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { Suspense } from 'react'\nimport { cookies } from 'next/headers'\nimport { cacheLife, cacheTag } from 'next/cache'\n\nexport default function DashboardPage() {\n  return (\n    \u003c\u003e\n      {/* Static shell - instant from CDN */}\n      \u003cheader\u003e\u003ch1\u003eDashboard\u003c/h1\u003e\u003c/header\u003e\n      \u003cnav\u003e...\u003c/nav\u003e\n\n      {/* Cached - fast, revalidates hourly */}\n      \u003cStats /\u003e\n\n      {/* Dynamic - streams in with fresh data */}\n      \u003cSuspense fallback={\u003cNotificationsSkeleton /\u003e}\u003e\n        \u003cNotifications /\u003e\n      \u003c/Suspense\u003e\n    \u003c/\u003e\n  )\n}\n\nasync function Stats() {\n  'use cache'\n  cacheLife('hours')\n  cacheTag('dashboard-stats')\n\n  const stats = await db.stats.aggregate()\n  return \u003cStatsDisplay stats={stats} /\u003e\n}\n\nasync function Notifications() {\n  const userId = (await cookies()).get('userId')?.value\n  const notifications = await db.notifications.findMany({\n    where: { userId, read: false }\n  })\n  return \u003cNotificationList items={notifications} /\u003e\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Migration from Previous Versions\n\n| Old Config | Replacement |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;experimental.ppr&#96; | &#96;cacheComponents: true&#96; |\n| &#96;dynamic = 'force-dynamic'&#96; | Remove (default behavior) |\n| &#96;dynamic = 'force-static'&#96; | &#96;'use cache'&#96;+&#96;cacheLife('max')&#96; |\n| &#96;revalidate = N&#96; | &#96;cacheLife({ revalidate: N })&#96; |\n| &#96;unstable_cache()&#96; | &#96;'use cache'&#96; directive |\n\n### Migrating unstable_cache to use cache\n\n&#96;unstable_cache&#96; has been replaced by the&#96;use cache&#96; directive in Next.js 16. When&#96;cacheComponents&#96; is enabled, convert&#96;unstable_cache&#96; calls to&#96;use cache&#96; functions:\n\nBefore (&#96;unstable_cache&#96;):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache'\n\nconst getCachedUser = unstable_cache(\n  async (id) =\u003e getUser(id),\n  ['my-app-user'],\n  {\n    tags: ['users'],\n    revalidate: 60,\n  }\n)\n\nexport default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise\u003c{ id: string }\u003e }) {\n  const { id } = await params\n  const user = await getCachedUser(id)\n  return \u003cdiv\u003e{user.name}\u003c/div\u003e\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAfter (&#96;use cache&#96;):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { cacheLife, cacheTag } from 'next/cache'\n\nasync function getCachedUser(id: string) {\n  'use cache'\n  cacheTag('users')\n  cacheLife({ revalidate: 60 })\n  return getUser(id)\n}\n\nexport default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise\u003c{ id: string }\u003e }) {\n  const { id } = await params\n  const user = await getCachedUser(id)\n  return \u003cdiv\u003e{user.name}\u003c/div\u003e\n}\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nKey differences:\n\n- No manual cache keys -&#96;use cache&#96; generates keys automatically from function arguments and closures. Here’s what’s going on.

## Git **does** track `drizzle-orm`

In `.gitignore` you ignore almost everything under `.agents/`, then **re-include** specific skills, including drizzle:

```42:52:/home/gonzalo/gonzalopozo.github.io/.gitignore
.agents/*
!.agents/skills/
.agents/skills/*
...
!.agents/skills/drizzle-orm/
!.agents/skills/drizzle-orm/**
```

`git ls-files` shows the skill is tracked, including references:

- `.agents/skills/drizzle-orm/SKILL.md`
- `.agents/skills/drizzle-orm/references/*.md`

## Why you don’t see **new** changes for that folder

`git diff` against `HEAD` for `.agents/skills/drizzle-orm/` is **empty** and `git status` doesn’t list drizzle at all — so **what’s on disk matches the last commit** for those paths.

So either:

1. The **bobmatnyc** version was **already committed** (e.g. the commit that touched that file), or  
2. Re-running `pnpm dlx skills add … drizzle-orm` wrote **the same content** again, so there is nothing new for Git to show.

Git only shows a change when file bytes differ from the index.

## `.cursor/skills/drizzle-orm` is a symlink

That path is tracked as a **symlink** to `../../.agents/skills/drizzle-orm`. You don’t get a second copy of `SKILL.md` to commit; edits go through to `.agents/skills/…`. If the symlink target didn’t change, Git won’t show a diff for drizzle there either.

## What **is** showing up in Git right now

Status is **not** empty for skills in general: deletions under `shadcn-ui` / `tailwind-v4-shadcn` and new untracked symlinks `shadcn` / `tailwind-design-system` under `.cursor/skills/`. **Drizzle** isn’t in that list because it didn’t change relative to the last commit.

**Short answer:** Git is registering the drizzle skill; you see no diff because there’s **no content change** to record for `drizzle-orm` right now.
